findings.title: `reasoning_effort` rejects "minimal", a value GPT-5 supports.
findings.body: The linked issue is about GPT-5 models, and GPT-5 accepts `reasoning_effort="minimal"`. This field (and the matching TypedDict field on line 53) only allows `Literal["low", "medium", "high"]`. So a GPT-5 config with `"reasoning_effort": "minimal"` fails Pydantic validation in `ChatCompletionClient.load_component`, and type checkers flag the same value when it is passed to the constructor. The PR description says `"minimal"` is included, but the code does not include it. Fix: add `"minimal"` to both Literals, then add it to the valid values in `test_reasoning_effort_validation`.
